title: Find a Grave, Michel Houle
proves: Born 29 September 1802, died 6 December 1898, buried Saint Genevieve Cemetery. The index maps the cemetery to Shoreham, Vermont; the death itself is filed under Anoka County, Minnesota.

title: Find a Grave and Minnesota county death, Zotique Houle
proves: One person, two records, same date of 24 October 1897: the memorial puts the burial at Saint Genevieve Cemetery, Shoreham, Vermont, and the Minnesota county death register puts the death in Minnesota. This is the proof that the Vermont mapping is an indexing error for Saint Genevieve, Centerville.

title: 1820 census, Gratis, Preble County, Ohio
proves: Jno L. Morkert heading a household at Gratis in Preble County, Ohio, the year before Elias Morkert was born in Ohio. An 1820 census names only the head of household.

title: 1870 census, Clay Township, Carroll County, Indiana, household 77
proves: One household at Clay, Carroll County, Indiana in 1870 holding Elias Merket, head, born Ohio; Elizabeth Merket, 43, born Ohio; Henry Merket, 19, born Indiana; Peter, 16; Catherine, 14; Markas, 11; and George N., 8, all born Indiana. NARA M593, page 11, line 18. The indexed age for Elias is 30, which cannot be right for a man whose wife is 43 and whose eldest children are grown.

title: Indiana marriage license, Henry N Market and Mary Thompson, 22 January 1875
proves: Henry N Market married Mary Thompson on a licence dated 22 January 1875 at Carrollton, Burlington Township, Carroll County, Indiana, page 68. This is the bride's own marriage record, so it establishes her maiden name without relying on a child's later recollection.

title: Social Security NUMIDENT record of Elizabeth Markert Hullman
proves: Elizabeth Markert Hullman, also written Elizabeth C Huffman, born 6 July 1875 at Delphi, Indiana, with her father given as Henry N Markert and her mother as Mary M Thompson.

title: 1900 census, Beaver Township, Benson County, North Dakota
proves: Henry Markert, head, 49, born February 1851 in Indiana, married 25 years, with both of his own parents given as born in Ohio; his wife Mary M., 44, born Ohio; and five sons all born in Indiana: Joseph C. 22, Gustave L. 18, Salamon D. 16, Levi N. 14 and Archie 12. ED 15, sheet 9A, line 10, NARA T623.

title: 1920 census, Blackduck, Beltrami County, Minnesota
proves: Henry Markert, 68, born Indiana, living as father in the household of his widowed son Gust Markert, 37, born Indiana, at Blackduck; his wife Mary, 61, born Ohio. Gust's six children were born in North Dakota, Alabama and Missouri. Henry's entry here gives his father as born in Ohio but his mother as born in Pennsylvania. Household 79, sheet 5A, NARA T625.
